title: Lived-in demo workspace
notes: Turn admin / admin into a realistic multi-month Northborn demo using the actual production module screens.
Seed multiple clients, employees, fleet units, historical/current/future jobs and linked dispatch assignments.
Seed completed work with field tickets, timesheets and paid/open/overdue/draft invoices so billing and reports look actively used.
Seed pre-trip and post-trip inspections, fleet defects, work orders, recurring maintenance and fleet documents.
Seed safety tickets and orientations, SDS and procedure library documents, FLHAs, incidents, near misses, hazard observations, toolbox talks and equipment inspections.
Seed price sheets, customer rate overrides, document templates, notifications, contacts, invites and client requests.
Keep the entire demo isolated in browser-local storage while Manager, Operator and Client views share the same coherent demo history.
